title: Automation Decision Guide: High-Frequency Bulk Batch Updates

steps.prompt: A nightly integration pushes 200,000 upserts in 1,000-record batches to Invoice__c. Business logic requires complex discount calculations across 5 child objects and partial-rollback on specific row errors. Which automation tool is required?

options.label: Record-Triggered Flow with Run Asynchronously paths and transactional fault handlers
options.distractorAntipattern: Record-Triggered Flow asynchronous paths cannot isolate row-level failures across 1,000-record batches or prevent CPU timeouts on multi-child traversals.
options.rationale: High-frequency bulk ingestion of 1,000 records per chunk traversing 5 child objects quickly exhausts Flow CPU limits and lacks granular partial-rollback control per row.

options.label: Apex Trigger framework with bulkified collections and Database.insert(records, false)
options.rationale: Apex delivers memory bulkification, strict CPU control, and granular partial success handling via Database methods for large batches.

options.label: Batch Apex class executing with default Database.Stateful and Database.allOrNone=true
options.distractorAntipattern: An allOrNone=true transaction strategy rolls back the entire 1,000-record batch chunk upon encountering any single record validation error.
options.rationale: An allOrNone=true transaction strategy rolls back the entire batch chunk when any single row fails, directly violating the requirement for partial-rollback on specific row errors.
